text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What is this lineup?!
It's insanely stacked!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Well, it's a Grand Prix just like the Arima, after all. But even so, it's quite an interesting lineup for this time of year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: To think that girl would come too—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Jordan.
You running in this one too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're running too!
Classmates, heyyy☆

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...That's as unenthusiastic a greeting as ever.
Still, to think you're in the Takarazuka too, huh."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And this is after two spring senior races, right?
Are you aiming for a solid standing befitting someone whispered to be the pinnacle of her generation?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Or, will you hunt down that other heroic classmate
of yours who's already roaming the world,
and seize your ticket to the top?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. What brings you all the way out here,
where the elite gather?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? I heard Golshi was running.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Still...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft, haha!
The hell is that?! You really are something else...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're an idiot beyond all imagination.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah!? Mmmph... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, not denying it, are you?
...Or rather, did you actually wish for it to be that way?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Talk about an unexpected pile-up of trouble.
Wonder how the dice are gonna roll this time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, I won't back down either.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Because Sensei told me to win.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...What Nakayama says is pretty tricky to grasp
almost every single time, though."

Still, just as Nakayama Festa said,
there are quite a lot of talented Umamusume
gathered here besides Gold Ship.

A high-level battle worthy of the name 'Spring Grand Prix' was anticipated.
...However.
choice_data_list: Let's put the complicated talk aside and focus.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Big mood. Totally relatable.
I'm done thinkin' about it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Welp, I'm gonna go blow 'em away, Trainer.
Gonna go become the strongest horse girl ever. Peace~

Charging head-on toward her goal without any scheming, clinging to it relentlessly.
That is her true strength.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Do I look cool?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Annoying!
Well then, I'm heading out.
